landing.lead: GnomeVPN brings up a WireGuard tunnel to a node in another country in one tap. No provider accounts, no logs, no ads. Just a clean channel.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Card payment via YooKassa. From {price} ₽ per month, cancel in one click, no hidden charges.
how.step2Body: Every node is a separate server with its own WireGuard. Switch on the fly.
how.step3Body: Through our app in one tap. Or download a config and open it in any WireGuard client: Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, Android.

faq.title: Questions
faq.a1: No. The server only knows that you have an active subscription and which node you picked. Browsing history is never collected or stored.
faq.a2: Access stays until the end of the paid period — you get exactly what you paid for. No further charges will be made.
faq.a3: Anything that runs WireGuard: macOS, Linux, iOS, Android — through a config downloaded from your account. Our own app is Windows-only for now, but it is not required.
faq.a4: We do not pay for influencer ads and we do not rent an office. The price covers servers and payment processing.

desktopOnly.title: Connect from the app
desktopOnly.body: The VPN tunnel runs on your device, so the connection can only be managed from the desktop app. Your account and payments stay available in the browser.
